abstract: A total of 320 intersex patients with a Y chromosome were classified into four groups; (1) gonadal dysgenesis, (2) asymmetrical gonadal differentiation, (3) virilizing male hermaphroditism and (4) feminizing male hermaphroditism (testicular feminization syndrome). Of these 320 cases, 98 were from the files of The Johns Hopkins Hospital and the remainder from the literature. The incidence of tumors in relation to age and clinical classification was analyzed by computer. The results were plotted for each group. It was found that the percentage of tumors rose appreciably soon after the age of puberty in the first three groups, and it was concluded that the gonads were best removed before the age of puberty. In the case of testicular feminization patients, procrastination until the age of 25 could be considered, if one were willing to assume the risk of neoplasia of about 3.6 per cent until then.
abstract_ja: Y染色体を持つ320例の間性患者を4群に分類した: (1)性腺異形成、(2)非対称性性腺分化、(3)男性化を伴う男性半陰陽、(4)女性化を伴う男性半陰陽(精巣女性化症候群)。このうち98例はJohns Hopkins Hospitalの診療記録から、残りは文献から得た。年齢および臨床分類別の腫瘍発生率をコンピュータで解析した。前3群では思春期以降に腫瘍の割合が著しく上昇したため、性腺は思春期前に摘出するのが最善であると結論された。精巣女性化症例では、25歳まで手術を先送りすることも検討しうるが、その間の腫瘍発生リスクは約3.6%である。
